layers.name: Reserve outer boundary (2023 extent, as far as public files draw it)
layers.reliability: Official files joined; about 182 km² of the notified reserve has no public map and is not included.

layers.name: Reserve and eco-sensitive zones, outer boundary
layers.reliability: Official files joined. Covers the reserve outline above plus both notified eco-sensitive zones, which also take in most of the village enclaves inside Bhainsrorgarh and part of the unmapped 2023 buffer. Some 2023 additions near Kota and in Bundi may still fall outside.

layers.name: Core 2013 (approximate)
layers.reliability: Approximate. No official file draws the core. This layer counts about 18 km² of Jawahar Sagar and Darrah buffer blocks as core and misses the 7.75 km² National Chambal core part.

layers.name: Buffer 2013 (approximate)
layers.reliability: Approximate, with the same misassignment as the core layer in reverse.

layers.name: Core added 2023: Bhainsrorgarh WLS forest blocks
layers.reliability: Official sanctuary file (2018). The notification adds 12 forest blocks (193.09 km²); the file draws the whole sanctuary, so the two differ. Sanctuary area is 201.4 km² in the file's attribute but 275.45 km² in the 2021 ESZ notification.

layers.name: Buffer added 2023: whole blocks a public file draws
layers.reliability: Only the three blocks the notification adds whole (Barkheda, Rawtha, Borabas-B; 2.74 km² notified), and most of that already lies inside the reserve file. The file draws Borabas-B at 0.50 km² against 1.38 km² notified. Part-blocks, compartments, the Bundi additions and the National Chambal piece have no public map.

layers.name: Eco-sensitive zone around MHTR (2020)
layers.reliability: Official ESZ file minus the reserve file. Notified as 0–1 km but up to about 4.7 km wide in places. Drawn around the 2013 reserve; part of it is now 2023 buffer.

layers.name: Eco-sensitive zone around Bhainsrorgarh WLS (2021)
layers.reliability: Official ESZ file minus the sanctuary file. Within 1.5% of the notified 304.70 km². The notification gives a width of 0–9.6 km, zero to the north and north-east where Jawahar Sagar and the national park adjoin. The file's BUFF_DIST attribute (3000) does not describe the drawn band.

layers.name: Mukundara Hills National Park (constituent unit)
layers.reliability: Official sanctuary or park file (2018). Outline only; it does not show core or buffer. Notified area is the file's own NOTIFY_ARE attribute.

layers.reliability: Official sanctuary or park file (2018). Outline only; it does not show core or buffer. Notified area is the file's own NOTIFY_ARE attribute.
